prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a hit while turning left in Houston, Texas, and has neck and back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1385; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather not give my full name on a recording, but you can note that I'm the driver of the vehicle involved.
Q: That's fine. Can you describe where the collision happened?
A: It was an intersection in Houston, Texas. I was making a left turn across the oncoming lane.
Q: What were you doing right before the impact?
A: I had stopped at the light, then got the green arrow and started the turn. The other car came through from the opposite direction, and we collided in the middle of the intersection.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle before you began your turn?
A: I checked, but it was farther back than I expected. I thought I had enough time to clear it.
Q: Were you injured?
A: Yes. My neck and lower back hurt right away. I've had stiffness and soreness since then, and I've been doing physical therapy twice a week.
Q: Have you seen a doctor?
A: I went to urgent care the same day, and I've been referred to a specialist for follow-up.
Q: Did the airbags deploy in your vehicle?
A: No, they did not. I was able to get out of the car on my own.
Q: Has anything about your condition changed since the first visit?
A: Some days are better than others. Sitting for long periods is still hard, and I sometimes wake up with pain.
Q: Is there anything you'd like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I'm cooperating fully and I want the claim handled fairly so I can get back to normal.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
A: Thank you.
